description: Aspen HYSYS is AspenTech's process simulator for the energy industry, which the company calls the market-leading and number one process simulation software, built on decades of experience with oil and gas and engineering, procurement and construction companies. It optimises upstream, midstream, refining and crude oil-to-chemicals processes in one environment, integrating models from gathering networks to processing facilities and keeping refinery planning models up to date, and it combines process simulation with tools for equipment design, costing, energy management, safety analysis and sustainable operations. Recent versions add AI-supported hybrid models that combine first-principles and data-driven methods, use of real-time data and high performance computing; Hydrocarbon Processing named it best modelling technology. Its use is global, in energy and chemical plants, and the same product family includes Aspen Plus. Access is commercial: the product page offers contact with sales, not prices or downloads. Caveats: it is proprietary, licence terms and prices are not published, and models need expert calibration. For simulation it provides steady-state and operational models of refineries, gas plants and chemical sites for design, digital twin, safety and energy studies. Related catalogue records include DWSIM and the CAPE-OPEN standard.
